scope: Previously credited Budget positive clicks in lots 11, 14, 16, and 17 only; CPU/read-only; no replay, GPU, heldout, or reserve access.

verdict.do_not_claim: This evidence does not prove the summary is a no-op; it proves only that useful effect has not been demonstrated.
verdict.reason: All seven proposed clicks land on plain pickup/return summary text on the Select a Car results page. The visible page supplies a distinct pencil-marked Modify Rental Details link as the explicit editing affordance. The original trajectory proves calendar behavior only for bordered date fields with calendar icons on the home search form, not for the later summary text. Because generated tool calls were not executed, no before/after transition establishes that a summary click opens any editor.
